why: Wahapedia's Exalted Sorcerer datasheet and NR both print "Arcane Shield (Psychic)".

NR "Arcane Shield (Psychic) - Exalted Sorcerer"; "this model" is the Exalted Sorcerer, an ability of his own datasheet. Model lines match NR (1 Exalted Sorcerer, 1 Aspiring Sorcerer, 1 w/ soulreaper cannon, 3 w/ warpflamer). The 4+ it gives the Rubric Marine and Aspiring Sorcerer lines (native 5+ on the Rubric Marines datasheet) carries a from: Arcane Shield mark and no footnote; the Exalted Sorcerer's own 4+ is his datasheet's (Wahapedia INSV 4+), so it rightly has no mark.
"In your Command phase": Command, your turn.
NR "Rebind Rubricae (Psychic) - Exalted Sorcerer"; "if this model is leading a unit" = the Exalted Sorcerer's own ability. Model lines match NR.

Rituals are selected only "at the start of your Shooting phase" (Cabal of Sorcerers, Rules Update wording), and the text says "this phase": your Shooting phase. Same reading as the approved Lord of the Planet of the Sorcerers / Arch-Sorcerer timings.

Grand Coven enhancement (GW Faction Pack Rules Update "Grand Coven Detachment, Incandaeum Enhancement"; Wahapedia "Incandaeum 15 pts"); NR lists it first in the Exalted Sorcerer's options (spelled "Incandeum"), and 115 = 100 + 15. The text is the Rules Update's word for word ("have already attempted"), the GW spelling of the name kept; NR's "Incandeum"/"has" are its own.
NR "Incandeum - Exalted Sorcerer"; "EXALTED SORCERER model only … the bearer" = the Exalted Sorcerer. Model lines match NR.

where: pubstomper · Exalted Sorcerer · Bringers of Change
why: NR "Bringers of Change - Rubric Marines": the Rubric Marines' datasheet ability; who names the unit it comes from, as approved for the previous Sorcerer-led build. Only the model lines changed (Sorcerer → Exalted Sorcerer), matching NR.

where: pubstomper · Exalted Sorcerer · Icon of Flame
why: NR "Icon of Flame - Rubric Marines"; the datasheet's "1 Rubric Marine can be equipped with 1 icon of flame" and NR name no bearer, so who names the unit (as approved before). Its IGNORES COVER marks are on Malefic Curse and Soulreaper cannon only (native on the warpflamers; the CHARACTER Exalted Sorcerer's weapons excluded, the Aspiring Sorcerer is not a CHARACTER).

NR Categories: "… Tzeentch, Battleline*, Rubric*, Rubric Marines*, Rubricae*, *from combined unit" — the same four, the same note as approved for the previous build; it says where the keywords come from, it answers no rules question.

NR roster: Exalted Sorcerer 115 (Wahapedia 100 + Incandaeum 15), (5) Rubric Marines 115; card 230 PTS = pts 230. The enhancement inside the leader's number, as in "140 + Scarab Occult Terminators 425".

Wahapedia's Exalted Sorcerer: "ARMY RULES Cabal of Sorcerers"; Rubric Marines: "ARMY RULES Cabal of Sorcerers (Aspiring Sorcerer only)". In this attached unit exactly the Exalted Sorcerer and the Aspiring Sorcerer have it ("models from your army with this ability").

Rubric Marines: "KEYWORDS – ALL MODELS: …; ASPIRING SORCERER ONLY: PSYKER"; Exalted Sorcerer: "KEYWORDS: INFANTRY; CHARACTER; GRENADES; PSYKER; CHAOS; TZEENTCH; EXALTED SORCERER". So the two models with PSYKER are those named; the unit still has the PSYKER keyword (a unit has a keyword if one model has it), which kw keeps.

Gear matches NR's four Options lines (the Incandeum enhancement left out, as Umbralefic Crystal on the Terminator Sorcerer); Wahapedia: Astral Blast, inferno bolt pistol, force weapon plus the optional Prosperine khopesh. Counts match (Warpflamer (x3), Close combat weapon (x4)); the weapons list has every NR row with its owner. Icon of Flame is printed only in the Abilities table, on no models line, so unplaced stays right.
